titleTr: Okul bölgesi duyuruları: tüm zamanlarda edilgen

explainTr: Edilgen yapıda önemli olan eylemi yapan değil, olan şeydir: The newsletter is sent every Friday. Kalıp: be + V3. Zamanı 'be' fiili belirler: is sent, was sent, has been sent, will be sent, is being sent, was being sent, had been sent.

Eylemi yapanı söylemek istersen 'by' kullanırsın: The rule was approved by the board. Yapan belli değilse ya da önemli değilse söylenmez. Okul bölgesi duyurularında bu yüzden çok edilgen görürsün: Parents have been notified.
Edilgen yapıda yalnız nesnesi olan (geçişli) fiiller kullanılır. 'Happen, arrive, sleep' edilgen olmaz: The meeting was happened yanlıştır, The meeting happened doğrudur.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede edilgenlik fiile eklenir (gönderildi, yapılıyor). İngilizcede ek yoktur: be fiili zamanı taşır, ana fiil V3 olur. 'Bina yapılıyor' = The building is being built.

reading.title: The Friday newsletter
reading.text:
Every Friday, Hafsa receives the district newsletter by email. This week's issue was longer than usual, so she made a cup of tea and read it carefully.

The first article was about the new schedule. "Starting in January, school buses will be rerouted," it said. "Parents have been notified by letter, and a new map has been posted on the district website. Students will be picked up fifteen minutes earlier at some stops." Hafsa wrote this down, because she would be working at Lincoln Elementary and might need to answer questions. Parents often call the office when a route changes, and she wanted to sound helpful and calm.

The second article explained why the gym at Lincoln Elementary is being renovated. The old floor was damaged by water last spring, and the heating system has not been inspected since 2015. "The work will be finished by March," the article promised. "Until then, physical education classes are being held outside or in the cafeteria."

The third article was about safety. A new rule was approved by the school board last Tuesday: all visitors must be checked in at the front office, and a photo ID will be required. "Visitor badges will be provided by the front office," it said. "Substitute teachers are asked to wear their badges at all times." Hafsa smiled. She already wore hers like a medal.

At the end, there was a short thank-you note. Volunteers had been invited to help at the winter concert, and more than forty parents had already signed up. "The concert will be held on December 12 at 6 p.m.," the note said. "Tickets can be bought at the front office."

Hafsa closed her laptop. She realized that she understood almost every sentence, even the long ones. Three months ago, a newsletter like this would have been impossible for her to read. Now it was just another Friday evening.

writing.promptTr: Velilere kısa bir okul duyurusu yaz (etkinlik, tadilat ya da yeni kural). Edilgen yapıyı en az beş kez, farklı zamanlarda kullan.
writing.promptEn: Write a short school announcement (120-180 words) for parents about an event, a repair or a new rule. Use the passive in at least five sentences and in different tenses.
frames: Dear parents, we would like to inform you that ...
The work will be finished by ...
writing.model: Dear parents, we would like to inform you about some changes at Lincoln Elementary. The gym is being renovated this winter, and the work will be finished by March. Until then, physical education classes are being held outside or in the cafeteria. A new bus schedule has been published on the district website, and a letter has been sent to every family. Please note that visitors are now asked to show a photo ID at the front office. Visitor badges will be provided, and they must be worn at all times. The winter concert will be held on December 12 at 6 p.m. Tickets can be bought at the office, and volunteers are still needed. The concert was planned by a group of parents, and many students have been invited to perform. If you have any questions, please call the office. Thank you for your support and understanding.
checklistTr: En az beş edilgen cümle var mı (be + V3)?
Farklı zamanlar kullandın mı (is being, has been, will be, was)?
Gereksiz yere 'by' ile yapanı yazmadın mı?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
